title: Capstone architecture and final mock interview
exp: The capstone ties all tracks together. The mock covers exactly the question types in the S&P Global Lead I round.
pts: Capstone: SQL Server -> Python extract -> S3 raw -> Spark validate+transform -> S3 processed Parquet -> Grafana dashboard.
GitHub README with architecture diagram, setup instructions, and a lessons-learned paragraph is the most-read part after the diagram.
Mock: 15 min system design, 10 min technical depth, 5 min STAR story.
Lead I signals: multiplying team output, owning decisions end-to-end, communicating trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.
pr: Push capstone to GitHub with README: architecture diagram, setup, lessons learned
Do the 30-minute mock interview and record yourself

viz.cap: Capstone pipeline -- ties all 5 tracks together

qa.q: Walk me through your capstone project end-to-end.
qa.a: Template using your real capstone: Source -> Python extraction (pandas+pyodbc) -> S3 raw -> EMR Spark validates and transforms -> Parquet partitioned by date -> Grafana dashboard (records, duration, errors). Idempotent via mode('overwrite'). State one honest thing you'd change -- for example, shuffle partitions set too high for the data volume.

qa.q: What is your 90-day plan as Lead I?
qa.a: Day 1-30: understand before changing -- read all code, run every job, interview the team, review 6 months of incidents. Day 31-60: deliver the highest-value lowest-risk improvement to build credibility. Day 61-90: propose the medium-term architectural improvement as a written document with trade-offs, lead the discussion, begin execution.
